goal: Preserve eternal Veil mystery rule and recover old Throne succession canon
body: Dave canon governance update, 2026-09-05. Shard 22695@db4 locks that selected VeilVerse questions may remain permanently unanswered. First explicit eternal mystery: WHO CREATED THE VEIL. Its ontology is known, originator is not to be revealed. Do NOT yet classify Nobunaga's Throne supersession as unknowable: archive contains older locked entries 'Veil Throne — Master Canon Lock' and 'CANON DECISION: The Pre-Nobunaga Throne Operator' resolving at least part of the Throne Succession Paradox. Fleet ask: recover exact body/text of the pre-Nobunaga decision from local vaults and report what was actually locked, especially how 1582 Nobunaga succession coexists with Xoah/Shadow Queen terminal Stage 10 ownership.
resolution: Captured as shard 24190@db1. Eternal Veil mystery rule acknowledged.
